prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in an empty sunlit stadium with green turf, a running track, standard-height gates and low stands behind her, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Nigerian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a bronze cube-shaped block, an iron ship's anchor, a copper square-sided cowbell, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold rings. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.

LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

A thick short neck, huge round shoulders, an enormously deep chest, a thick powerful midsection with a solid belly, tree-trunk arms, and huge thick legs planted wide. Heavy, dense and immovable, every part solid. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
